messages:
Lina Ramos: Morning — quick wrap from me for today. Got my workstation mostly set up, but hitting a couple of access hiccups.
Alex Chen: hey lina! which hiccups exactly?
Lina Ramos: GitHub org invite didn't arrive for the infra repo, and VPN drops periodically when I try to pull large docker images.
Maya Patel: @Alex can you re-send the org invite? sometimes the org auto-invite bounces if email alias is used.
Alex Chen: sent a re-invite to the address on your profile. can you check spam? I also added a direct invite to the infra repo.
Lina Ramos: got the repo invite now, thanks. Trying a clone — `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/infra.git`
Samir Gupta: for the VPN drops, what's the error? is it the company VPN or the cloud VPN?
Lina Ramos: company VPN (WireGuard). Logs show connection resets after ~2-3 minutes. Haven't tried from home network yet.
Maya Patel: we saw flaky wireguard performance from certain ISPs last month. Try `wg-quick down wg0 && wg-quick up wg0` and then tail the logs: `sudo journalctl -fu wg-quick@wg0`.
Lina Ramos: ran those, attached a clipped log: ```
Mar 10 09:12:02 wg-quick[2345]: Peer x.pubkey: handshake failed: connection timed out
Mar 10 09:12:05 networkd-dispatcher[987]: link state change: UP -> DOWN
```
Alex Chen: hmm. @Samir — could be MTU or agressive ISP NAT. I'll pair with Lina at 11:30am PT to test from my hotspot.
Samir Gupta: also check Docker pull via `--max-concurrent-uploads` if it's choking on big layers. e.g. `docker pull --max-concurrent-uploads=1 ...`
Lina Ramos: thanks — will try that.
OnboardBot: Reminder: new-hires orientation Q&A at 3pm PT in #new-hires.
Lina Ramos: blocker-wise: waiting on laptop ergonomics stipend approval (people ops pinged), and an SSH key added to the infra deploy user so I can test deploy scripts.
Alex Chen: I'll add your SSH key to the deploy user after our pairing session. For stipend, @Maya can you check status with people ops?
Maya Patel: pinged people-ops, should be confirmed by EOD.
Lina Ramos: today I'm going to finish the infra repo walkthrough, open a tiny docs PR to sanity-check the CI, and shadow Samir on the deploy smoke test. If VPN still flakey I'll switch to hotspot for the smoke test.
Samir Gupta: sounds good. if you open the PR tag it WIP and drop me a link, I'll do a quick review.
Alex Chen: and I'll review CI bits after you push. :thumbsup:
Lina Ramos: thanks all — see you at 11:30 for pairing.
Maya Patel: welcome again! feel free to drop questions here.
